description: Dept. of Trade and Investment Policy - Order to impose a Special Commodity Levy on Broken rice, w.e.f. 02.08.2017
categorisation: This gazette content involves the imposition of a Special Commodity Levy under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It contains regulatory provisions, specifies levy rates, and rescinds a previous order. This falls under legal/regulatory matters (new regulations, statutory instruments, and compliance requirements) rather than government personnel/structure changes or other specialized categories.
